title: Req2Rust: A Requirements-Guided Agent Harness for Project-Level C++-to-Rust Migration
abstract: arXiv:2611.07442v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory-safety concerns make Rust an attractive target for modernizing legacy C/C++ systems, yet project-level C++ migration must balance semantic fidelity with Rust-oriented reconstruction. Source-structure-preserving migration can track low-level behavior, but it can also carry source-language organization, unsafe idioms, and project assumptions into Rust. Direct agent-based translation gives the model more freedom to construct a Rust project, but semantic coverage depends on the model identifying the source behaviors that must be preserved. This problem is especially acute for C++, where source behaviors are often hidden in object models, destructor-driven lifetime protocols, and other hard-to-localize C++ semantics. This paper presents Req2Rust, the first project-level LLM-based C++-to-Rust migration harness. translated_title: Req2Rust：一种需求引导的智能体框架，用于项目级C++到Rust的迁移
translated_abstract: 内存安全问题使Rust成为对遗留C/C++系统进行现代化改造的理想目标，然而项目级的C++迁移必须在语义保真度与面向Rust的重构之间取得平衡。保留源代码结构的迁移能够追踪底层行为，但也可能将源语言的组织方式、不安全惯用法以及项目假设带入Rust中。直接基于智能体的翻译给予模型更多自由来构建Rust项目，但语义覆盖范围取决于模型能否识别出必须保留的源行为。这一问题在C++中尤为突出，因为C++的源行为往往隐藏在对象模型、析构函数驱动的生命周期协议以及其他难以定位的C++语义之中。本文提出了Req2Rust，这是首个项目级的基于大语言模型的C++到Rust迁移框架。Req2Rust首先推导出一个有证据支撑的迁移需求规范（MRS），用于记录需要保留的行为和约束条件。
tldr: Req2Rust是首个项目级基于大语言模型的C++到Rust迁移框架，通过先从源代码中推导出有证据支撑的迁移需求规范（MRS）来引导智能体完成迁移，在语义保真与符合Rust习惯的项目重构之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: Req2Rust is the first project-level LLM-based C++-to-Rust migration harness that derives an evidence-grounded Migration Requirements Specification (MRS) to guide agents in balancing semantic fidelity with Rust-oriented project reconstruction.
